name: Grimand Elmore
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and I need them sent to Grimand Elmore.  He's here in the Dwarven District, in the weapon shop.

And duck when you give these to him.  He's fiercely proud of his skills, and won't like the idea of learning something from me...
narrative.objectives: Bring Furen's Notes to Grimand Elmore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Furen wrote this? How dare he! Why, I taught him everything he knows! To think he could teach me something is outrageous! Outrageous!

Hm... but there is something in his notes that I'd like to try...
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, and well met. How might I be of service to you?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 20 to 30, 10,125 XP in all.

quests.name: The Rethban Gauntlet
quests.objectiveText: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed. You must not die and release your spirit.

quests.name: The Shieldsmith
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

quests.name: Fire Hardened Mail
quests.objectiveText: Gather the materials Furen Longbeard requires, and bring them to him in Stormwind.

quests.name: Grimand Elmore
quests.objectiveText: Bring Furen's Notes to Grimand Elmore.

quests.name: Burning Blood
quests.objectiveText: Bring 20 vials of Burning Blood and 1 Burning Rock to Grimand Elmore in Stormwind.
